jobs.title: Program Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**Abode Services**, one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a Program Coordinator I for our program in San Jose, CA. ***\* Please be advise the shift for this position is: Tuesday- Friday 12:00 PM-8:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM***

**About Abode:**

At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

**Our Values:**

We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!

**The Diverse Culture:**

We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.

**About The Role**:

The Program Coordinator will supervise the provision of services to program participants in the County, through direct staff supervision of staff.

**How You Make An Impact**: :

* Supervise the provision of housing for programs in the County through direct supervision of staff.
* Improve housing program skills through supervision, coaching, and training of staff. Address performance issues, as necessary.
* Provide support to the team when dealing with complex participant and/or landlord issues, which may include leading case conferencing meetings, connecting staff with other community resources for support, and providing direct services to clients/landlords.
* Provide housing location services for clients and ensure collaboration with appropriate Abode staff to ensure subsidy payments.
* Complete initial and annual HQS inspections accurately and on time.
* Maintain relationships with property owners and manage housing stock. This will mean developing new landlord contacts, as well as maintaining current units.
* Communicate closely and frequently with all members of the housing and services team to improve systems, solve problems, share resources, and coordinate work.
* Ensuring timely completion of HMIS annual updates, and quarterly/yearly income assessments as needed.
* Maintain housing files and support Compliance Specialists to ensure program compliance.
* Attends staff meetings and other agency functions as needed. Oversee audits and monthly program reports as needed.
* Maintain unit/participant information in WMAT. Run rent reports and ensure property owner payments.
* Ensure accuracy of participant rent calculations and upload to WMAT/participant files.
* Work with the manager/finance team to ensure appropriate budget maintenance. Review monthly MER reports.
* Maintain knowledge of HUD regulations/prepare files for monthly audits with the County.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field and equivalent experience.
* 2 years of field experience working with people with co-occurring disorders and/or who are homeless.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of valid California Driver's License and current auto insurance, along with a clean DMV record, is required.
* Driving and transportation of participants when required.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.

COMPETENCIES:

* Professional experience in the human services, social work, psychology, or related field and demonstrated experience in rental housing programs for low income, special needs individuals and families.
* Ability to work within a housing first philosophy and Harm Reduction model and lead others to work with these models.
* Basic knowledge and understanding of applicable federal, state, and local laws.
* Excellent verbal & written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business-related applications.
* Ability to build supportive and respectful working relationships with transition age youth that instills hope and promotes self-determination using a strengths-based approach.
* Possess an understanding of and practice cultural sensitivity through open dialogue and self-exploration with diverse groups, while providing direct services.
* Ability to effectively intervene in crisis situations and make sound decisions in difficult situations with participants.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.

**Our Benefits and Perks:**

* **Compensation: $33.65-$37.02 (DOE)**
* **Schedule:** Full-time, Non-Exempt
* **Work Arrangement:** Onsite**Shift :** Tuesday- Friday 12:00 PM-8:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM
* **PTO**:19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays**: 12 paid holidays per year
* **Health & Wellness**:
  + 100% medical, dental and vision coverage options for employees
  + Agency dependent health care contribution
  + Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  + Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  + Retirement Plan: 403(b) Plan w/ Employer Match & Contribution Programs
* **Voluntary Benefits**:
  + Commuter Assistance
  + Life Insurance
  + Legal Services
* **Mission Driven Culture**: Join

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Program Coordinator

**Department Name:** GGU Worldwide

**Position Reports To:** Associate Director of Administration and Partner Support, GGU WW

**FLSA STATUS**: Salaried

**Salary Range:** $70,304.00

**Benefits:** The University's comprehensive benefits program

**Days & Hours:** Monday through Friday, 37.5 hours per week. The standard work schedule is 9:00 am to 5:30 pm, maybe adjusted. A flexible schedule may require evening and weekend hours.

**BASIC FUNCTION AND SCOPE:**

The Program Coordinator provides timely, high-level administrative and academic support to GGU Worldwide’s Deans and Faculty Directors. This position is responsible for supporting the day-to-day administrative and coordinative operations of various international partner programs, requiring strong attention to detail, excellent interpersonal skills, cross-cultural communication, technical and AI skills, a commitment to student-centered service, academic quality assurance, and accreditor compliance. The role demands the ability to multi-task and adapt to varied responsibilities and time zones across GGU Worldwide programs, stakeholders, platforms, and geographies. The Program Coordinator provides dedicated administrative and logistical support to GGU Worldwide’s partnerships.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Work collaboratively as part of the GGU Worldwide administrative team to deliver timely, quality, and focused care and support to students, faculty, staff, and partners.
* Assist Faculty Directors with course scheduling, syllabi management, instructor selection, student evaluations, timesheet tracking, record keeping, and other academic operations.
* Support Faculty Directors with pre-admission, enrollment, verification, course enrollment, attendance monitoring, student standards status, WASC reports, translation/interpretation, and academic quality initiatives and etc.
* Use platforms such as Curriculog to support curriculum changes and Smartsheet to manage course schedules.
* Serve as the point of contact for partner adjunct faculty onboarding, support, and coordination.
* Assist Dean and Associate Dean with special projects and doctoral programs.
* Assure GGU Worldwide courses and programs in the GGU Catalog, all websites, and social media pages, and marketing materials are up to date.
* Course schedule planning, coordination, confirmation, and oversight.
* Help Faculty Director and Deans monitor faculty-student course engagement.
* Coordinate with other university departments, including Student accounts, Division of Student Success, facilities, schools, among others.
* Assist deans, faculty directors and faculty on outreach, partner relations, and students’ associations.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments and meetings; utilize strong judgment in managing priorities of requests and escalating as necessary for resolution and/or prioritization.
* Prepare documents, reports, agendas, presentations, and related materials.
* Assist with on campus and off campus events, orientations, immersions, commencement, and other activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Education requirement:
  + Bachelor's degree; Master’s degree a plus
* Years of experience:
  + Two to five years’ experience in academic program support role or similar is preferred.
* Knowledge of:
  + English and other languages is preferred but not required.
  + Curriculog, Salesforce, Colleague, and Smartsheet are preferred but not required.
  + AI tools, LinkedIn, and short messaging apps including WhatsApp, WeChat, Viber.
* Direct job-related requirements:
  + Familiarity with CRM and learning management systems
  + High level of proficiency with modern office practices, procedures, equipment, and software, including Microsoft Office Suite, Zoom, MS Teams and other office technology.
* Skills and abilities:
  + Ability to work on-site at the San Francisco, California campus.
  + Ability to work off-site activities including but not limited to immersions, study tours, community events.
  + Strong interpersonal and bilingual skills with the ability to maintain positive and professional relationships with students, faculty, staff, and partners.
  + Ability to work in a multicultural, diverse, and inclusive environment.
  + Excellent interpersonal, administrative, communication, and organizational skills.
  + Outstanding command of the English language in written and verbal forms.
  + Ability to effectively interpret, organize, and present information and ideas in writing.
  + Excellent project management skills, including ability to simultaneously manage several projects and activities, as well as use AI tools.
  + Work effectively both as a leader and as a team member to support departmental goals, providing assistance across programs while consistently prioritizing the best interests of students and graduates.

**Supplemental****Information**

To apply: Please go to http://www.ggu.edu/jobs to submit an application, letter of interest, and a resume.

In applying for a position, candidates sign a consent authorizing a broader inquiry which may include reference checks, a motor vehicle check, and a third-party background check.

jobs.title: Digital Literacy Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Conard House is a committed equal opportunity employer.

**DUTIES:**

* Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.
* Design and implement training programs that will help improve and enhance daily living for consumers.
* Assist consumers with job search process, including resume revision, cover letter composition, and online applications.
* Assist consumers with troubleshooting on personal tech devices, platforms, and processes. Maintain the ability to adjust approach(es) as needed to best suit consumer needs.
* Host/train consumers and volunteers on video conferencing platforms/software to allow clients to learn, participate/engage in virtual activities and virtual learning opportunities.
* Coordinate workshops, guest speakers, and special events that promote digital inclusion and community engagement.
* Deliver personalized strength-based training; encourage and support participant interaction.
* Coordinate, train, support, and oversee volunteers and interns assisting with Digital Literacy programming.
* Develop and disseminate program materials to all Conard sites.
* Conduct program outreach, both internally at associated Conard sites as well as with potential and established external partners.
* Coordinate class scheduling with site supervisors in the community.
* Design group activities that promote social connection opportunities for consumers.
* Track program objectives and class attendance, including individual usage and student progress.
* Collect & compile data for distribution of monthly reports and input data into the appropriate database.
* Coordinate Digital Literacy program inventory, including ordering and tracking incoming and outgoing devices.
* Maintain accurate program records and ensure compliance with agency, contract, and confidentiality requirements.
* Manage technology equipment, coordinate security of equipment at sites, report issues with equipment or lab operations.
* Coordinate and network with other agencies that are participating in SF Connected. Attend meetings as required.
* Maintain a classroom environment suitable for collaborative learning.
* Be available to assist consumers virtually and remotely.
* Others duties as assigned.

High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Must have at least two years of experience in a technology-focused, educational, or human services role working with diverse populations. Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate ideas, information, and technical concepts to individuals and groups with varying levels of knowledge, education, and digital literacy, while providing troubleshooting, training, and technology guidance in a supportive and accessible manner. Demonstrate positive customer service and client-centered approaches when interacting with participants, staff, volunteers, and community members. Must be comfortable with public speaking, group facilitation, and delivering presentations, classes, or workshops. Demonstrate experience developing, implementing, and evaluating curriculum, educational materials, or training programs, as well as coordinating projects and collaborating effectively across diverse teams, departments, and community partners. Experience working with and supervising volunteers is highly desirable. Must complete a background check after conditional job offer.

jobs.title: Fellowship Program Coordinator – Anesthesiology
jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 3 months

**Work Schedule:** The standard work schedule is 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. or 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m., with flexibility in scheduling on most days. **Wednesdays have a required schedule of 6:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m. onsite at Mission Bay to provide conference support.**

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care is seeking a Fellowship Program Coordinator to support the administration and operations of its medical fellowship education programs.

The Fellowship Program Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support for ACGME-accredited and non-ACGME fellowship programs, including Pain Medicine, Pediatric Anesthesia, and Obstetric Anesthesia. Working with fellowship program leadership, faculty, fellows, and Graduate Medical Education stakeholders, the coordinator supports scheduling, educational activities, recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, accreditation and compliance, evaluations, reporting, and maintenance of program records.

The position also coordinates departmental Grand Rounds and M&M conferences, fellowship and residency didactic activities, and fellowship moonlighting operations.

This is a full-time, hybrid position requiring four days onsite and one day offsite. Work locations include Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion. The schedule varies based on program needs, and the position must be available to begin work at 6:30 a.m. on Wednesdays to provide onsite setup and operational support for departmental Grand Rounds.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Fellowship Program Administration & Educational Coordination**

* Provide administrative and operational support to Program Directors and Associate Program Directors for Obstetric Anesthesia, Pain Medicine, and Pediatric Anesthesia fellowship programs.
* Assist in creating and maintaining annual fellowship rotation and call schedules.
* At the direction of program faculty and leadership, create program and curricular evaluation documentation, including evaluation tools, strategies, and timelines.
* Generate regular evaluation reports and maintain evaluations and work-hour information in MedHub.
* Coordinate logistics for program activities, including recruitment, orientation, graduation, conferences, simulation activities, and other educational or assessment activities.
* Coordinate special events, lectures, journal clubs, and conferences, including conference room reservations and food orders.
* Coordinate speakers for journal clubs and conferences.
Assist with committee meetings, including Program Evaluation Committee and Clinical Competency Committee meetings, as applicable.  

**Grand Rounds & Didactic Program Coordination**

* Coordinate and provide operational support for the Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care's weekly Grand Rounds and M&M conferences.
* Provide onsite setup and program support beginning at 6:30 a.m. on Wednesdays.
* Coordinate didactic sessions and lecture series for fellowship and residency education in Pain Medicine, Pediatric Anesthesia, and Obstetric Anesthesia.
* Coordinate scheduling, faculty and speakers, room and virtual meeting setup, and program communications.
* Track attendance and completion requirements.
Maintain educational calendars and related program documentation.  

**Accreditation & Regulatory Compliance**

* Assist Program Directors with preparation for Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) site visits and internal reviews.
* Gather and enter information requested by Program Directors for the annual ACGME Accreditation Data System (ADS) update.
* Track completion of annual ACGME program surveys by fellows and faculty.
Maintain program records and support compliance with accreditation standards and other regulatory requirements.  

**Fellowship Recruitment, Appointments & Onboarding**

* Perform fellowship match responsibilities through ERAS and SF Match.
* Coordinate fellowship interviews, including faculty scheduling, conference room reservations, tours, and transportation.
* Maintain professional and informative communication with prospective candidates regarding interview schedules and program-related questions.
* Correspond with newly matched fellows regarding appointments and hospital appointment processes.
* Monitor credentialing requirements to help ensure fellows are appropriately credentialed before beginning rotations.
* Assist with operational components related to learner employment, including HR onboarding, appointment paperwork, credentialing, training grants, payroll and FTE tracking, benefits and leave advising, and Medicare reimbursement reporting.
Assist fellows completing their programs with separation and offboarding paperwork.  

**Non-ACGME Fellowship Program Support**

* Support Program Directors for non-ACGME fellowship programs.
* Serve as a point of contact for prospective candidates, current health professions education learners, and other program stakeholders.
* Respond to questions, disseminate program information, and assist learners with program-related issues.
* Assist with applicable accreditation processes.
Assist fellows with separation paperwork.  

**Fellowship Moonlighting Coordination**

* Ensure fellows participating in moonlighting activities have appropriate medical staff privileges.
* Coordinate with fellowship coordination staff regarding fellow schedules.
* Monitor compliance with UCSF work-hour policies.
Process payments associated with fellowship moonlighting activities.  

**Administrative Operations & Program Reporting**

* Support administrative, financial, and other program operations in accordance with accreditation standards and regulatory requirements.
* Prepare reports and conduct necessary follow-up.
* Monitor trainee schedules to support compliance with curriculum standards.

jobs.company: Life Skills Training and Educational Programs - LifeSTEPS
jobs.title: Program Coordinator/Youth Mentor
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **San Jose, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 10 hours per week
* **Job Location:** San Jose, CA
* **Rate of Pay**: $21.00 per hour

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**About us**

LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

**Our Benefits**

In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off

**About the Position**

The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.

**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**

* Empower children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing services.
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support individuals and families so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? Apply today!!!

**Please Note**

***LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status. Please provide us with notice if you will require accommodations during the interview process***

For over three decades, Cirtec Medical has been a leading outsourcing partner for complex medical devices. We specialize in providing comprehensive solutions for Class II and III devices, from design and development to precision components and finished device assembly. Our expertise spans neuromodulation, implantable drug delivery, cardiac rhythm management, structural heart, mechanical circulatory support, and minimally invasive surgical systems.

Our dedicated teams prioritize growth, innovation, and collaboration. We actively seek opportunities for improvement to enhance our support for clients. If you embrace a growth mindset and thrive on challenges, you may be a perfect fit for our team!

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
Gator Bio is a bioanalytical technology company located in Palo Alto, CA. We are creating innovative technologies to solve difficult problems facing today’s biopharma industry. We develop, manufacture, and sell instruments, biosensors, reagents, and consumables for antibody, gene, and cell therapy development. Gator Bio’s current product portfolio includes biolayer interferometry (BLI) systems using optic fiber biosensors.

We are looking for a **QA Specialist** to join our Quality Assurance team. The QA Specialist will play an important role in maintaining the company’s established Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with applicable quality requirements, and supporting the continuous improvement of quality system processes.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Quality Management System**

* Maintain the established Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with applicable standards and company procedures.
* Promote awareness and compliance with quality requirements across the organization.

**Document and Change Control**

jobs.title: Research Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About AfterQuery**
====================

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

**Why Apply**
=============

**Massive Opportunity:** Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

**Founding Impact:** You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

**Equity & Growth:** Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

**Strong Team:** Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

**Overview**
------------

AfterQuery is hiring a Research Program Manager to run the operations behind its research programs: public benchmark releases, collaborations with academic and industry partners, and the research roadmap. You own the coordination, external relationships, and progress tracking that keep the program moving, and you are welcome to contribute to the research itself, from benchmark design to co-authoring publications.

This is a technical, hands-on role, not a pure coordination one. You will read results tables, run evals, sanity-check numbers before they go public, and turn loosely specified research needs into engineering and operational roadmaps. You will also be the program's voice to external partners, so clear writing and confident communication across researchers, executives, and academics are as important as technical fluency. You work daily with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and go-to-market partners.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the point of contact for collaborations with academic and industry partners, including fellowships, grants, and joint research projects, and run each from scoping through delivery.
* Coordinate benchmark releases end to end, from launch checklist through publication, and keep releases on cadence.
* Maintain AfterQuery's leaderboards and benchmark sites, and verify every result before it goes to a community leaderboard or publication.
* Track progress across all active research projects. Anticipate resourcing gaps and technical bottlenecks, unblock projects that fall behind, and escalate with a clear recommendation when a timeline or scope needs to change.
* Coordinate the expert pool for upcoming benchmarks: forecast expert needs, manage capacity, and keep contributor logistics running.
* Write the program's external and internal communications: launch briefs, partner updates, planning documents, and status memos that turn technical detail into clear, actionable summaries.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 1-3+ years in research operations, technical program management, or a similar role in a fast-moving research or engineering organization.
* Technical background in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field, with working Python and SQL.
* Evaluation literacy: you have taken part in evaluating a product, an agent, or a foundation model, can read a results table, and can tell when a number should not be trusted.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can distill a technical result into a summary a partner, executive, or academic collaborator can act on, and you write documents people actually read.
* A track record of running cross-functional programs end to end, including managing external partners, contractors, or collaborators.
* Comfort with ambiguity and building processes from scratch, and the judgment to keep processes light so researchers stay effective.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Graduate degree or research experience in a technical field.
* Contributed to a benchmark, dataset, or evaluation project in any role.
* Familiarity with public leaderboards or open research communities.
* Exposure to programs with external partners, such as fellowships, grants, or academic collaborations.
* Exposure to expert or annotator pools, or other human-data work.
* Comfort with lightweight dashboards or building small tools with AI assistants.

**Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):**
----------------------------------------------

* Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental
* 401(k) with Employer Match

* Monthly Wellness Stipend

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Promex Industries specializes in custom assembly processes focusing on complex microelectronics and small component assemblies that require precise fabrication. With a longstanding presence in Silicon Valley, Promex offers a fully integrated, US-based facility dedicated to supporting biotech instrument and medical device companies from prototype to full-scale production.

**Position Summary:**

The Quality Assurance Technician supports and maintains the company's Quality Management System (QMS). The Technician administers the training and calibration programs, maintains controlled quality records, supports internal and external audits, and helps drive nonconformance, corrective action and quality data activities to closure. Working alongside the QC Inspector, the Technician applies inspection expertise (IPC workmanship standards, sampling plans and precision measurement) to support incoming and outgoing inspection, resolve acceptance questions and provide inspection backup when needed.

**Essential Duties:**

**QMS Operational Support**

· Administer the calibration program: maintain the equipment list and recall schedule, coordinate outside calibration vendors, review calibration certificates for acceptability, perform and record in-house verifications, and quarantine and report out-of-tolerance equipment.

· Maintain the training program, including the training matrix by position, the training schedule, and tracking of due, overdue and recurring training and re-qualifications.

· Schedule and coordinate training sessions with internal trainers, department supervisors and outside providers; notify employees and supervisors of upcoming and overdue training.

· Prepare for and support internal, customer and registrar audits by retrieving records, demonstrating processes and following up on findings.

· Document nonconforming material (NCMR), support MRB disposition, and gather objective evidence for corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) and supplier corrective actions (SCAR); track actions to closure.

· Collect, check and verify quality records to ensure the activities are completed as planned.

· Conduct ESD, 5S and in-process audit.

· Support material compliance management and compile compliance reports per guidance

**Inspection**

· Serve as technical resource to the QC Inspectors and operators on borderline acceptance questions.

· Conduct incoming, in-process and outgoing inspection of purchased materials and SMT assemblies to IPC-A-600/IPC-A-610, drawings and customer requirements.

· Perform specialized measurements using a Micro-Vu (or equivalent) vision measuring system, calipers, micrometers, gauges and microscopes, X-ray imaging, and XRF for plating thickness and RoHS/material verification.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· High school diploma or GED.

· 5+ years of working experience and 3+ years of quality experience in an electronics manufacturing (SMT/PCBA) environment, including support of QMS operation.

· Working knowledge of IPC-A-610; familiarity with IPC J-STD-001 and IPC-A-600.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, with accurate data entry.

· Working knowledge of QMS requirements (e.g., ISO 9001) for training, calibration, document control and records.

· Understanding of attribute sampling plans (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 and c=0) and basic calibration concepts (traceability, tolerance, recall intervals).

· Hands-on experience with precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges) and inspection microscopes

· Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs and specifications.

**Key Competencies:**

· **Organization & Follow-Through:** Manages schedules, due dates and recalls so that training and calibration never lapse, and follows open items to closure.

· **Computer Literacy:** Familiar with Microsoft Office, QMS software and other applications for record maintenance; learns new systems quickly.

· **Technical Judgment:** Applies acceptance criteria consistently and escalates borderline conditions appropriately.

· **Documentation Discipline:** Keeps records complete, accurate, legible and on time.

· **Attention to Detail:** Catches gaps and errors in records as well as workmanship and dimensional defects.

· **Communication:** Follows up clearly with employees, supervisors, vendors and the QC Inspector on training, calibration, inspection and corrective action items.

· **Integrity & Independence:** Holds the line on quality requirements under schedule pressure.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Associate degree or technical certificate in electronics, manufacturing or quality technology.

· Current IPC-A-610 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS); J-STD-001 certification a plus.

· Experience in an ISO 13485 or AS9100 quality system, including participation in audits.

· Experience with a Micro-Vu or other vision/CMM measuring system, and with XRF, X-ray or AOI inspection equipment.

· Experience in MIL-STD-883 optical inspection.

**Work Environment:**

· Combination of quality office and manufacturing/inspection-lab environment, including ESD-controlled areas and cleanrooms; requires wearing ESD/cleanroom equipment.

· Regular computer work for record maintenance, plus periods of sitting or standing at microscopes and inspection stations with close visual work and fine hand manipulation.

· Occasionally lifts and moves materials up to 25 lbs.

· Works with XRF equipment that emits ionizing radiation; must follow the company radiation safety program.

· This position may require access to export-controlled (ITAR) technical data; if so, the candidate must qualify as a U.S. Person.

Join us at Promex Industries where your expertise will directly contribute to the production of high-quality medical devices that make a difference worldwide!

jobs.title: Sr. Event Technology Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Manager, Event Technology Operations** to build and lead the Event Technology Operations discipline across AMD’s global event portfolio. This role will own the operational strategy, capabilities, standards, service model, and delivery of event technology, ensuring technology enables scalable, reliable, and engaging event experiences.

This role will serve as the strategic and operational bridge between Global Event Marketing and AMD’s MarTech organization, translating event, audience, and business requirements into technology capabilities and operating models. The successful candidate will partner closely with the Event Technology Product Manager within MarTech, who owns the technical platforms and product roadmap, while leading the Event Technology Operations function responsible for implementation, readiness, adoption, and delivery across the portfolio.

### **THE PERSON**

You are a strategic technology and operations leader who enjoys solving complex challenges at the intersection of events, technology, and customer experience. You bring a strong blend of operational excellence, stakeholder management, technology expertise, and business acumen. You can translate evolving business needs into scalable solutions, influence cross-functional partners, and build high-performing teams that deliver reliable and innovative event experiences. You thrive in dynamic environments, remain calm under pressure, and are passionate about enabling exceptional experiences through technology.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Event Technology Operations Strategy:** Define and own the Event Technology Operations strategy, operating model, standards, and service approach across AMD’s global event portfolio.
* **Capability Strategy & Evolution:** Establish the capabilities, processes, services, resource models, and vendor ecosystem required to support the evolving portfolio and identify opportunities to improve and scale the event technology experience.
* **MarTech Partnership:** Serve as the senior Event Marketing partner to the Event Technology Product Manager and MarTech organization, translating portfolio, event, audience, and business requirements into technology needs and influencing the broader event technology roadmap.
* **Portfolio Technology Planning:** Partner with portfolio and functional leaders to understand future event requirements, identify common technology needs, and establish portfolio-level priorities and approaches.
* **Strategic Program Leadership:** Serve as the Event Technology Operations lead for AMD’s highest-priority and most complex event programs, including Advancing AI, owning the event technology approach, integrated requirements, readiness, and delivery while applying insights from these programs to evolve the broader Event Technology Operations capability.
* **Technology Standards & Governance:** Establish standards, processes, workflows, documentation, data requirements, readiness expectations, and governance for event technology implementation across the portfolio.
* **Resource & Service Planning:** Define the resource, vendor, support, and service models required to deliver event technology effectively across programs, balancing centralized expertise, external support, and portfolio demand.
* **Technology Readiness & Risk:** Establish portfolio-wide testing, readiness, escalation, contingency, and risk management frameworks to ensure reliable live-event deployment.
* **Vendor & Investment Management:** Lead operational relationships with event technology vendors and service partners and develop recommendations related to service models, scope, investments, performance, and future requirements.
* **Stakeholder Leadership:** Advise Event Marketing leadership, portfolio owners, and functional stakeholders on technology capabilities, investment requirements, risks, opportunities, and trade-offs.
* **Adoption & Enablement:** Establish training, documentation, support, and adoption models that enable event teams and stakeholders to use event technology effectively and consistently.
* **Performance & Optimization:** Establish functional success measures, evaluate technology performance and user feedback, and partner with MarTech and vendors to drive continuous improvement.
* **Team Leadership:** Build, lead, coach, and develop the Event Technology Operations team, establishing clear accountability, development opportunities, and a scalable talent model as the capability evolves.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Extensive progressive experience in event technology, event operations, marketing technology, digital experiences, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading event technology capabilities across large-scale, complex, or global event portfolios and programs.
* Experience developing operating models, standards, services, and scalable approaches for event technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of registration, attendee management, mobile experiences, lead capture, onsite technology, event data workflows, integrations, and related event technology capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business, audience, and event requirements into technology strategies and operational solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with Product Management, IT, MarTech, and business organizations while maintaining clear functional ownership.

* Serve on the Accident Review Committee and maintain written preventability criteria so that determinations are consistent and defensible.

* Establish a functional Safety Committee of operators and staff to review safety concerns and make recommendations to management for additional safety efforts.
* Own AP3's written safety programs, including the Injury and Illness Prevention Program, heat illness prevention, workplace violence prevention, emergency action and hazard communication plans.
* Build and manage the dash cam coaching program, including event review workflow, severity thresholds, coaching documentation and driver scorecards.
* Assist operations and maintenance departments in identifying additional or refresher training needs based on current trends within the employee base.

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The California Collaborative for Public Health Research (CPR3) advances public health through research, partnerships, and evidence-informed strategies that strengthen collaboration among academic institutions, public health agencies, healthcare organizations, and community partners. CPR3 supports initiatives that translate research into practice and improve the health and well-being of California communities.

The Public Health for All Californians Together (PHACT) Coalition, co-led by the California Department of Public Health, Covered California, and CPR3, is a statewide network of more than 1,400 members representing over 400 organizations committed to strengthening evidence-based public health policy, service delivery, and culturally responsive communication. While the Coalition's current priorities include immunization policy, vaccine access, coverage, and culturally responsive communication, its broader mission is to strengthen public health infrastructure, safeguard scientific integrity, and promote equitable access to life-saving preventive services for all Californians.

The CPR3 Project Manager will provide day-to-day operations support, including project management, communications, stakeholder engagement, and strategic coordination for the PHACT Coalition and other CPR3 initiatives. Reporting to the CPR3 Director of Operations and Strategy, the incumbent will provide program management, knowledge management, and program and policy analysis support to the PHACT Coalition Community Partnerships Working Group. The incumbent will lead planning and execution of bi-monthly coalition meetings, including agenda development, speaker coordination, meeting logistics, preparation of meeting materials, facilitation, and post-meeting follow-up.

In collaboration with Coalition leadership, the incumbent will develop and implement communications strategies that keep members informed of emerging public health issues, promote engagement across the statewide network, and increase coalition visibility. Responsibilities include developing newsletters and other communications, maintaining coalition communication platforms, supporting dissemination of evidence-based resources, and identifying opportunities to strengthen partner engagement.

The position will also support coalition membership management, stakeholder engagement, donor reporting, and tracking of project milestones and deliverables. The incumbent will build and maintain productive relationships with state and local public health agencies, academic institutions, healthcare organizations, and community-based organizations while contributing to the continuous improvement of coalition operations and workflows.

The successful candidate will demonstrate excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills and contribute to the continued growth and impact of the PHACT Coalition. The ideal candidate will have 2–4 or more years of experience in program management, public health communications, and collaboration with academic institutions, public health agencies, and community-based organizations. Experience supporting multi-sector partnerships and statewide initiatives is highly desirable. An MPH or related graduate degree is preferred but not required.

  

**Department Overview:**

The Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics (DEB), housed within the UCSF School of Medicine, is the largest department of epidemiology in the University of California system. DEB is the epicenter of many of UCSF’s initiatives in population health, data science and informatics, health service research, health equity and artificial intelligence. The DEB has three missions: 1) education, 2) science, and 3) research. Its educational mission is to train students in epidemiologic and biostatistical methods for studying disease etiology and prevention, evaluating tests and treatments, and using evidence-based approaches in clinical practice and population health. The scientific mission of the DEB is to perform outstanding basic, clinical and population health research along a spectrum from molecules to society and to develop tools for the translation of knowledge that will improve clinical practice and population health and ensure optimal use of resources. The clinical mission of the Department is to support the practice of public health and preventive medicine in local, state, national and international health agencies.

  

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Three or more years of project management experience in healthcare, academia, public health or social service sector
* Three or more years of experience with public health communications
* Three or more years of experience with academic and governmental programmatic collaborations
* Three or more year of experience working with community-based organizations
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing. 2+ years of experience applying broad communication strategies to execute cross-sectoral initiatives.
* Three or more years of project management experience in healthcare, academia, public health or social service sector
* Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes, and ability to manage competing priorities among multiple parties and stakeholders.
* Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Analytical / problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of common organization- or research-specific and other computer application programs. Experience with online tools that support multi-institutional collaboration and data sharing, such as Zoom, Asana, Trello, Airtable, Google Workspace, Tableau, etc.
* Demonstrated experience working with partners that represent a broad array of interests

**Preferred:**

* Strong policy analysis techniques and applied research skills
* Master’s Degree in Public Health

Stanford University is one of Silicon Valley's largest employers - and one of the most unique. Our mission is to educate future leaders and promote interdisciplinary, world-class research and teaching. This passion makes Stanford an intensely creative, rewarding, and challenging place to work. At Stanford University, not only are you part of an exceptional team that values innovation and education, but you also become part of a culture that brings out the best in you. Stanford is committed to fostering a workplace culture that promotes diversity, collaboration, and professional growth. Our culture offers career development programs, competitive pay that reflects market trends and benefits that increase financial stability and promote healthy, fulfilling lives.

Research—the creation of new knowledge—is key to Stanford’s educational mission. Stanford research has led to breakthrough remedies, devices, tools, and concepts, and hundreds of initiatives solely for the betterment of humanity. Among the inventions and discoveries that have resulted from Stanford research are MRI technology, DNA cloning, the Pill, heart transplantation, and digital music.

Stanford is investing unprecedented resources in the Office of Research Administration (ORA) due to a growth in the research enterprise that continues to surpass 12% yearly. The Contract & Grant Officer position provides high-quality, personalized services and expertise to support our faculty and campus community. ORA submits over 5,000 new proposals, reviews and negotiates over 7,000 agreements, and manages more than 7,500 active sponsored projects annually with a total research budget approaching $2 billion.

The Property Management Office (PMO) is an integral part of the Office of Research Administration (ORA). Through a network of approximately 300 Department Property Administrators (DPAs) throughout the University, PMO ensures equipment is effectively managed from the time of acquisition through disposal. PMO is responsible for the oversight, accounting, compliance, training, and implementation of policies and procedures to manage a $1.3 billion dollar infrastructure of *moveable equipment* used in support of the education and research mission of Stanford.

This position is eligible for an onsite or hybrid work arrangement.

The expected pay range for this position is $90,293 to $104,000 per annum. Stanford University provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of the salary or hourly wage the university reasonably expects to pay for a position upon hire. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, geographic location and external market pay for comparable jobs.

At Stanford University, base pay represents only one aspect of the comprehensive rewards package. The Cardinal at Work website (https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards) provides detailed information on Stanford’s extensive range of benefits and rewards offered to employees. Specifics about the rewards package for this position may be discussed during the hiring process.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Training and Communications Program Manager in the Property Management Office (PMO) provides overall leadership, coordination, and management of the program. They may report to the Assistant Director or Senior Director. Under general supervision, they will be a primary contributor for implementing and maintaining a broad array of training, communication, and outreach initiatives on behalf of PMO. They will regularly interact and collaborate with co-workers and represent PMO when providing guidance and direction, customer service, assistance, and leadership to DPAs and other University personnel.
  
  
Key elements for success in this role include having demonstrated knowledge of curriculum development and delivery of in-person, virtual, and self-guided training. Others include understanding equipment life cycle management concepts, accounting, industry standards and regulatory compliance, as well as PMO policies, procedures, and systems. Familiarity with the Stanford environment and culture is very helpful.

* Collect and analyze data, create reports, review and explain trends; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program or function.

* Represent the program or function as the key contact and subject matter expert within the department, unit or school. Commit resources and provide information and/or training. May also represent the program or function to external/internal stakeholders and constituencies.

* May direct staff to perform various tasks and assignments. May also supervise staff.

Bachelor’s degree and three years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :

jobs.description:
**QUALITY ASSURANCE TECHNICIAN**

**Company:** VahatiCor  
**Status:** Full-time, Nonexempt  
**Location:** Onsite, Santa Clara, CA  
**Reports to:** Chief Operations Officer • Manufacturing

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

VahatiCor is a venture-backed medical technology company developing a new cardiovascular therapy. As the company grows beyond its startup incubator, it is building the quality systems and infrastructure needed to support its next stage.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Quality Assurance Technician will inspect and test materials, components, subassemblies, and finished cardiovascular medical devices. As a member of the Quality team, this person will also carry out material control and nonconformance activities, maintain manufacturing and inspection records, and participate in validation activities.

This is a hands-on role requiring medical device industry experience and the ability to work in compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), approved procedures, and established quality system requirements. Inspection activities include handling small components and spending extended periods looking through microscopes.

This person will work closely with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering. Success requires excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, accurate documentation, and a responsive, service-oriented approach to colleagues.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Inspection and Testing**

* Perform incoming inspection and testing of medical device materials and components using approved specifications, inspection procedures, and sampling plans.
* Collect and evaluate quality documentation accompanying incoming materials, including certificates of conformity, supplier inspection records, and other required documentation.
* Perform in-process inspection and testing of subassemblies and final inspection of completed medical devices.
* Inspect materials and products for applicable dimensional, visual, workmanship, labeling, and packaging requirements.
* Use microscopes for detailed inspection of small components, assemblies, and finished devices, including extended periods of microscope use.
* Use calipers, micrometers, height gauges, gauge blocks, optical inspection and measurement equipment, and other approved tools appropriate to assigned inspections.
* Document and communicate inspection results, test results, and nonconformances according to approved quality system procedures and good documentation practices.
* Work in cleanroom and electrostatic discharge-protected areas, as applicable, following required procedures for gowning, contamination control, and material handling.

**Material Control and Nonconformance Activities**

* Carry out material control procedures, including receipt verification, identification, quarantine, and movement of materials to and from Quality.
* Verify material identification, part numbers, revision levels, lot or serial numbers, quantities, and inspection status against approved documentation.
* Maintain material control, nonconformance, work order, and serial number logs and databases, as assigned.
* Identify and document nonconforming materials or products and coordinate their segregation and status labeling to prevent unintended use.
* Participate in the investigation, disposition, and documentation of nonconforming materials by gathering inspection results, measurements, manufacturing records, and other relevant information.
* Perform approved reinspection or verification following authorized rework or other disposition decisions.
* Escalate unresolved discrepancies and recurring defects to the appropriate Quality, Manufacturing, or Engineering personnel.

**Manufacturing and Quality Records**

* Contribute to and maintain lot records and Device History Records, including required inspection, manufacturing, and traceability information.
* Review records for completeness, accuracy, legibility, required signatures and dates, and use of current approved document revisions.
* Identify missing entries, inconsistent information, or incomplete approvals and coordinate correction with the responsible personnel.
* Follow good documentation practices when recording results or making corrections, preserving original information and required audit trails.
* Maintain organized records that are readily available for Quality review, product acceptance or release activities, audits, and retention.

**Inspection Procedures and Measurement Equipment**

* Develop and update inspection procedures, measurement programs, forms, and checklists in coordination with Quality and Engineering and through established document approval procedures.
* Identify unclear inspection instructions or acceptance criteria and obtain clarification before proceeding.
* Ensure inspection and measurement equipment is maintained and calibrated as required.
* Verify equipment calibration status and suitability before use and report damaged equipment, inconsistent readings, or other concerns that could affect results.
* Maintain inspection tools and work areas according to approved handling, storage, and housekeeping procedures.

**Validation Activities**

* Participate in the execution of approved process validation and test method validation protocols.
* Perform assigned activities for installation qualification, operational qualification, and performance qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), including inspection, measurement, and data collection.
* Participate in gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies to evaluate consistency of measurements across equipment and operators.
* Document results accurately and communicate deviations, unexpected findings, or execution questions to the responsible Quality or Engineering personnel.

**Quality System Compliance and Audits**

The ARIA Non-Invasive Neurostimulation/Neuromodulation (NINM) Frontier Science Hub Initiative is a new multi-million dollar multi-year privately-funded endeavor in the Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences, led by Vice Chair for Research Dr. Andrew Krystal. This groundbreaking research program aims to advance scientific discovery and develop innovative NINM therapeutic opportunities for individuals with profound autism. As a high-profile, multi-institutional research venture, the ARIA NINM Frontier Science Hub spans a consortium of three leading universities—Yale, Stanford, and UCSF—and will support up to 15 new multi-site and department-based research programs. The initiative will involve complex financial structures, including numerous subawards, subcontracts, and the active engagement of dozens of faculty Principal Investigators.

**Custom Scope**

This position exists to serve as the strategic and operational leader responsible for ensuring the successful development, implementation, and management of the ARIA NINM Frontier Science Hub Initiative in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences. Acting as the senior administrative partner to faculty leadership, the incumbent provides oversight across all facets of program administration, ranging from high-level strategic planning to day-to-day operational management, including staff supervision and budget management. The incumbent drives long-term planning and program-wide strategies in collaboration with faculty leadership, identifying opportunities for growth, creating and refining policies and procedures, and aligning all efforts with the initiative’s overarching goals. Acting as a liaison across the consortium, the incumbent facilitates seamless communication and collaboration, attending regular consortium meetings and coordinating efforts with the advisory board, external agencies and funders to maintain compliance and foster strong relationships. The incumbent provides oversight of ARIA’s complex financial structures, including subawards and subcontracts, ensuring transparency, accountability, and efficient allocation of resources across diverse research programs. Additionally, expertise in financial management, staff supervision, policy development, and stakeholder engagement is critical to ensuring the Initiative’s success

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates

jobs.description:
**Schedule**: Monday to Friday (8am-4:30pm)

**Pay:** $25.50-$38.50

**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs , LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

LifeMoves’ Homeless Outreach Teams (HOT) conduct outreach to unsheltered individuals experiencing homelessness. HOT collaborates with multiple internal and community organizations to provide holistic services to help the individuals return to stability. HOT is a subset of a larger Outreach team that includes Rapid Response Dispatch and an Encampment Resolution team.

The HOT Case Manager supports unsheltered individuals in accessing housing, healthcare, and other vital resources. Through direct outreach and intensive case management, they build trust, set client-centered goals, and provide flexible, trauma-informed support. Reporting to the Program Director, the CM meets clients where they are and helps guide them toward stability and self-sufficiency, while also engaging with the broader community through education and advocacy.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop, implement, and revise individual case plans with housing/employment/benefit/health and well being tasks based on client strengths and goals.
* Support clients with tasks including but not limited to housing searches, employment preparation, benefits access, life skills development, build resumes, cover letters, and navigate employment and housing resources.
* Support clients with enrollment into benefit programs including but not limited to General Assistance, CalFresh, and Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants.
* Coordinate with health care access to understand and support client physical and behavioral health needs. Assist clients by scheduling medical appointments, arranging transportation, and accompanying them to appointments as needed.
* Facilitate client-centered groups, workshops, or education sessions to build skills and confidence.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community partners by building strong relationships, connecting clients to needed resources and services, and educating the community on client needs and trauma-informed care.
* Coordinate with relevant public partners, for example probation officers, Veterans Affairs, Adult Protective Services (APS), Child Protective Services (CPS) and city, state, and federal agencies, to support client needs and program goals.

**Client Advocacy, Mediation, and Conflict Resolution**

* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords, employers, or agencies to support successful outcomes. Provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Advocate for client rights and reduce stigma around homelessness and mental health challenges. Advocate for clients' needs and strengths when working with partners, landlords, employers, and other agencies.

**Data Tracking and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, case notes, reports, and program data in line with agency standards and confidentiality laws utilizing Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the LifeMoves internal client management system
* Track client progress, program outcomes, housing placements, employment and learning successes, and community partnerships.

**Crisis Management and Safety**

* Provide crisis intervention and make referrals to appropriate services when needed.

**General Agency Responsibilities**

* Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
* Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying what you learn to your daily work.

  + Training expectations in the first 90 days of employment include but are not limited to CPR, Mental Health/First Aid (MHFA), Nonviolent Crisis Intervention Training, HMIS and internal database training.
  + Additional required trainings through our online Learning Management System Relias include but are not limited to Client's Experience of Trauma-Informed Care, Working with Individuals Experiencing Homelessness, Overview of Serious Mental Illness for Paraprofessionals, Working with Individuals Experiencing Homelessness and Substance Use Disorder, An Overview of Substance Use Disorders, Strategies for Preventing and De-escalating Hostile Situations, Recognizing and Responding to a Person in Crisis, Maintaining Professional Boundaries, Overcoming Barriers to LGBTQ+ Affirming Behavioral Health Services, Privacy and Confidentiality for Non-HIPAA Covered Entities, Child/Elder/Dependent Abuse Prevention and Mandated Reporting, Preventing, Identifying, and Responding to Abuse and Neglect, Reporting Elder and Dependent Adult Abuse in California, Iden

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

Since launching in 2019, Starface has turned the historically negative experience of having acne into a more joyful, relatable one with a category of its own: expressive and effective products that make people feel good. * Write and maintain quality SOPs, policies and standards; manage document control, change management and periodic document reviews
* Maintain Product Information Files (PIFs)
* Keep quality records current in the QMS (specs, COAs, ILs, SDS, test results, lot codes, shelf life/PAO)
* Train cross-functional teams on quality requirements and document training

* Set up, execute and approve line trials; track first productions for new launches
* Own quality gates in the NPD stage-gate process with PD and Operations
* Book and manage third-party inspections (e.g., Factored Quality); define sampling plans and rework procedures
* Maintain production color/print standards, rangeboards and retained samples

* Maintain and enhance systems for quality metrics, deviation tracking, risk assessments, and continuous improvement programs.

**About us:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

This role serves as the final point of contact for complex member issues, including health plan grievances, RD grievances, and advanced member account support and food benefits escalations. * A completely private, secure, and quiet workspace.
