MedStar Health is seeking highly **qualified, experienced, and customer-focused professionals** to join our **Customer Service** ***Call Center*** **team** as a Customer Care Specialist. **Medical billing experience and knowledge are essential for this position.** We are looking for a candidate with a demonstrated background in medical billing, exceptional customer service skills, and the ability to confidently and professionally handle customer inquiries.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:30 AM–6:00 PM

As a Customer Care Specialist, you will serve as the primary post-service contact for the MedStar Health Customer Service Call Center. Identifies the nature of inquiries, discerns potential implications for internal & external entities. Using both MedStar billing systems (IDX and SMS), internal/external resources, applications, and processes to resolve cases. Provides a single point of contact from origin through final resolution for all patient billing, coding, service, and insurance concerns. Uses appropriate guidelines and discretionary authority to make decisions concerning proper resolution of documented service recovery cases. Special emphasis on educating the patient, building rapport and service recovery is all aimed at enhancing the patient experience.

Primary Duties:

* Advocates on the patients’ behalf to achieve best results, gain patients’ trust and build rapport. Interacts regularly with patients, MedStar Health staff from all areas, collection agency liaisons, website vendors, outside labs, etc. Uses established guidelines to make independent decisions concerning specific patient issues in need of resolution. Answers and resolves patient/guarantor inquiries daily, via telephone, mail, fax, and email. Meets the departmental weekly standards for calls taken, mail handled, and other forms of customer contacts resolved. Meets specific standard turnaround times as they apply to number of calls answered, speed of answer, hold time, personal call abandonment rate, etc. Meets expected turnaround times for resolving interdepartmental issues, cases deemed “urgent” or in need of special handling, and response time to customers.

* Serves as the single point of contact for the patient. Liaises, advocates, research, and analyzes documents, records, prior precedent-setting cases, discusses and reviews with both internal and external sources, etc., until final adjudication or resolution is achieved. Uses MedStar Health's billing systems and the MedStar Payment Portal to help customers with their billing and payment concerns. Annotates invoice or account after each inquiry to ensure proper documentation of inquiries and resolutions. Ensures correct upload of documents for proper retention. Knowledge of the functions of all MedStar Health’s non-telephony methods of customer contact.

* Applies knowledge of MedStar Health’s Managed Care contracts and the associated rules for claim processing to achieve proper reimbursement and customer satisfaction. Participates in training sessions, workshops offered, staff meetings, work events, task force, committees, and community outreach efforts. Communicates to leadership any system or procedural problems/inconsistencies to prevent problem recurrence and/or to improve existing processes. Corrects invoices and accounts in both systems that have erroneous registration and/or insurance information and ensures all associated claims have the correct financial classification for timely processing/reprocessing.

* Exemplifies Spirit Values in all activities in areas of service, resource utilization, high quality outcomes and effective communication. Interviews patients in need of referral or recommendation to appropriate support and/or charity care programs. Proposes budget/payment plans to customers as the situation warrants and in accordance with MURCO policies and Maryland State regulations. Keeps abreast of regulatory and specific changes as they relate to HCFA 1500 and UB04 billing requirements and payer-specific follow-up. Maintains departmental QA standards within established error rate. Meets the established standards for abandoned calls, duration of calls and the amount of time that patient is held in queue, etc.

Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or GED
* 2 years’ experience in patient accounting or related healthcare field.
* 1 year of customer service experience.
* Associate or bachelor's degree preferred.

This position has a hiring range of : USD $20.57 - USD $36.27 /Hr.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Program Manager to own the day-to-day delivery of a large federal health IT program and serve as a primary client-facing point of contact. This position will be fully remote within the United States, with some meeting-related travel.

Responsibilities:

Directs all phases of programs from inception through completion. Responsible for the schedule and performance of company programs or subsystems of major programs. Acts as primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with the customer to discuss, schedule, and technical performance. Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to master plans and schedules, identifies program problems and obtains solutions, such as allocation of resources. Directs the work of employees assigned to the program.The program is governed through an Integrated Product Team model with regular steering-level oversight, and delivery runs on a two-week sprint cadence inside a weekly client-workstream  
rhythm. The right candidate is comfortable holding the client relationship, running a structured  
operating model, and surfacing risk early and plainly

* Manages one or more programs of size and complexity, may manage an operating/field office, and supervises professional and technical personnel performing in their customary disciplines.
* Maintains aggressive efforts to achieve objectives.
* Prepares manpower staffing plans, including skill and labor mix, to support contract operations. May be responsible for recruiting, interviewing, and hiring staff.
* Monitors contract compliance and deliverables.
* Acquires follow-on business associated with areas of responsibility and supports new business development.
* Translate client priorities into delivery direction and represent delivery status, risks, and decisions to the client clearly and credibly.
* Maintain the dependency map across the seven workstreams and keep entangled workstreams synchronized, so issues are worked before they cascade.
* Work with the managers to balance staff across workstreams, watching for concentration risk where individuals carry multiple workstreams or where a workstream has thin backup coverage.
* Maintain the program risk register, surface strategic risks explicitly and early, and own mitigation tracking.
* Ensure delivery artifacts are accurate, internally consistent, and traceable across documents — a recurring need in a multi-workstream program.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 15+ years of experience. (or commensurate experience)
  + 7+ years of program or project management experience, including  
    direct management of staff.
* Demonstrated experience as a primary client-facing point of contact on a complex  
  program, owning the relationship day to day.
* Experience running a structured delivery operating model across multiple concurrent  
  workstreams, with hands-on dependency, risk, and action management.
* Working knowledge of Agile / SAFe delivery, including sprint planning, PI planning, and  
  cadence-based coordination

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience in federal health IT, VA / VHA programs, or other regulated government health  
  environments.
* PMP, SAFe (e.g., SAFe Agilist / RTE), or equivalent certification.
* Experience supporting clinical or EHR-adjacent technology rollouts at enterprise scale.

Posted Salary Range: USD $155,000.00 - USD $175,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: CX Team Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At **Havenly Brands**, we're building this generation's premier destination for all things home. Alongside our award winning Havenly design services, we proudly own and operate some of the best home furnishings brands in the business including Havenly, Interior Define, The Citizenry, Burrow, Inside, and St. Frank. Our family of brands is growing and we're looking for amazing people to join us on this journey!

Havenly is not just the #1 residential interior design service in America - we're architecting the future of how millions design their homes. With our proprietary 3D visualization technology, our worldwide network of designers empowered with AI tools, and our revolutionary customer-facing AI design assistant, we're at the inflection point of a massive market transformation. This isn't just another operations role, it's the opportunity to build the category-defining business at the intersection of AI, design, and commerce.  
  
**Our Core Values**

* **Exhibit Gumption:** meet every challenge with spirit and energy; believe the impossible is possible.
* **Overperform:** work hard, move fast, be scrappy.
* **Stay Playful:** no jerks, no whiners; have fun and keep perspective.
* **Act Like an Owner:** be accountable, speak up, act in Havenly's best interest.

### **About the Role**

As our CX Team Operations Specialist, you'll own the day for one of our brand CX teams: queue health, work rebalancing, daily huddles, the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve, and coverage when the Team Lead, Customer Experience (your manager) is out. This is an operations role, not a people-management role: no direct reports, coaching, check-ins, performance management, hiring decisions, staffing plans or team KPI ownership, which all stay with the Team Lead. The person we're looking for is a steady, organized, solutions-oriented go-to who keeps queues healthy, makes sound policy-aligned calls on tough cases, and stays close to customers by handling contacts 40 to 50% of the time.

**What You'll Own**

* Monitor queues, channels and backlogs throughout the day, flagging volume spikes, aging tickets and SLA risk.
* Rebalance work across the team as directed by the Team Lead.
* Run daily huddles and share updates, policy changes and known issues.
* Provide coverage and continuity for day-to-day operations when the Team Lead is out of office.
* Share a short end-of-day read on queue health and open issues with the Team Lead.
* Take the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve and own them through to resolution.
* Make sound, policy-aligned decisions on exceptions using the same refund, credit and exception approval authority as the Team Lead, and know when to escalate further.
* Partner with the Team Lead on the most sensitive escalations, bringing clear case summaries and recommended solutions.
* Act as the go-to resource during the day for questions on policies, procedures and systems.
* Guide agents through tricky cases in the moment, and share observations on agent strengths and gaps with the Team Lead, who owns coaching.
* Support onboarding as a buddy for new team members.
* Coordinate with internal partners, especially Logistics and Order Operations, to resolve day-to-day issues on individual orders and cases.
* Spend 40 to 50% of your time handling customer contacts via email, chat, SMS and phone, delivering clear, timely and empathetic communication focused on first-contact resolution, in each brand's unique voice.

**What You'll Drive**

* Identify recurring escalation themes and share them with the Team Lead to inform training and process updates.
* Reinforce established processes and quality standards, and keep team reference materials current in partnership with Systems and Tools.
* Gather frontline feedback on technical, product and marketing program issues and pass it to the Team Lead.

### **We Are Looking for People Who**

* Have **2+ years** of hands-on experience in Customer Experience, Customer Support or a related role (ideally in e-commerce or home goods), including handling escalations and complex customer issues with empathy and sound judgment.
* Bring experience as a subject matter expert, team buddy or acting lead supporting peers day to day, plus hands-on experience with modern CX tools (e.g., Kustomer, Gladly, NetSuite), including macros and knowledge bases.
* Bring a basic understanding of how fulfillment and logistics operations affect the customer experience, strong problem-solving skills, the ability to stay calm and organized in a fast-paced environment, and excellent written and verbal communication.
* Approach ambiguous problems by figuring out what's broken and acting on it, not waiting to be told what's next.
* Move fast, take real ownership of outcomes, and hold themselves to a high bar.
* Collaborate well across teams, with a low-ego, no-drama approach to getting things done.

Bonus points if you also have experience with **monitoring queues or real-time operations in a contact center**.  
  
At Havenly, we're building with AI as part of how we work. We're looking for people who are genuinely curious about AI-assisted tools and eager to adopt them; this is about openness, not existing expertise.

### **The Details**

* **Employment type:** Full-time, hourly, non-exempt contract position. *This contract does not convert to a Havenly employee role.*
* **Location:** Remote in USA or Philippines
* **Compensation:** $26 to $28.50/hr USD or $8.75 - $10/hr PHP
* **Benefits:** As a contract position, this role is not eligible for Havenly benefits.
* **Application deadline:** October 30, 2026, unless further applications are needed.

**Interview Process**

We try to follow the below interview process but sometimes find that you or we want to have further conversations. The below process is ideal state, but this can change!

* **Hiring Manager Interview:** with Teague Fuller - Team Lead, Customer Experience. A chat to learn about your experience, what you're looking for next,

jobs.title: Customer Experience Associate (West Coast)
jobs.description:
**Keep Growing with Nutrafol**
------------------------------

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients - and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too - by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

**About you:**

Be the voice that makes someone’s day better.

At Nutrafol, our customers come to us during a vulnerable, sometimes emotional moment in their lives. How we show up for them, with empathy, expertise and a little creativity, is what sets us apart. We’re looking for a Customer Experience Associate to be that voice: the person who turns a frustrated email into a loyal customer and a potential shipping mishap into a five-star moment.

If you’re a natural problem-solver who thinks on your feet, loves working with people, and wants to support and enhance the Nutrafol customer journey - this is your role!

**This position is open to candidates based in the Pacific timezone.** Work schedule is: Tuesday-Saturday, 9am-6pm PT.

You will report to the Manager, Customer Experience.

**What you’ll do:**

* Be the first (and best) voice our customers hear, on the phone, over email, wherever they need you.
* Be the go-to person for tricky questions and escalations; where you will turn tough moments into resolved ones.
* Help customers navigate the Nutrafol website and products with confidence and ease
* Become a true Nutrafol product expert - someone customers trust because you actually know the ins and outs.
* Get creative. No script can cover everything and we want you to find the solution that fits the person in front of you.
* Help shape how the team runs day to day; using your exceptional prioritization skills when tasks and queues start to grow, manage ad-hoc projects as they’re assigned, and always looking for ways to raise the bar for the CX team.

**What you bring:**

* 1-3 years of experience directly supporting customers - via phone, email or chat, handling everything from routine questions to resolving complaints; at an e-commerce company or fast-moving startup.
* Proficient using tools such as ZenDesk, Salesforce, Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Stellar written and verbal communication skills – you aren’t afraid to hop on the phone, write an email, or send a chat to help a customer.
* A genuinely positive, can-do attitude where you see problems as puzzles, not roadblocks.
* Curiosity about health and wellness science; enough to speak knowledgeably about our products and the “why” behind them.
* You are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial spirit! You’re ready to jump in - no job is too big or too small.
* A real love for people. You light up when you turn someone’s day around.
* Bonus points if you’re bilingual in English/Spanish.

**What you can expect in the interview process**:

* Talent Acquisition Interview

* CX Manager Interview

* Take-Home Exercise

* Final Interview

* Offer

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. That only happens when the people using our tools understand them, trust them, and have a clear path to get help when something isn't working. Strong product operations is how we close the gap between what we build and how it's used every day.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both **hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers**. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

**Who You Are**

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end implementation project for assigned customers, from post-Solution Alignment through configuration, training, UAT, go-live, and transition.
* Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day customer lead throughout onboarding, owning timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, customer actions, and overall project health.
* Translate approved Solution Architecture designs into accurate, scalable Vividly platform configuration.
* Configure customer workflows, master data, promotion structures, deduction-related settings, reporting requirements, user access, and other applicable platform components based on the approved solution.

This role owns every inbound call and, separately, owns direct referrals end to end (from providers, hospitals, facilities, and community partners) through intake and prep, then hands the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach. MIF list referrals are out of scope for this role. The ideal candidate is warm and calm under pressure, catches clinical red flags, and keeps calls and referrals moving without anything falling through the cracks.  
  
*At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states with a strong preference for those EST based: California, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.*

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, meeting call answer rate and service level targets, and flagging volume or staffing risks to the Shared Services Manager.

**Your experience and qualifications**

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Automotive SaaS
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

At myKaarma, we’re not just leading the way in fixed ops solutions for the automotive industry—we’re redefining what’s possible for dealership service centers. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and powered by a global team, our industry-leading SaaS platform combines communication, scheduling, and payment tools in one seamless solution that keeps dealerships and vehicle owners connected. With myKaarma, every service interaction flows effortlessly, bringing good karma to customers and service teams.

Rooted in the principles of the Toyota Production System, we operate with precision, efficiency, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement to deliver a better experience for all. We’re looking for innovators, problem-solvers, and tech enthusiasts passionate about building solutions people love to use. If you’re ready to make an impact in an industry ripe for change, join us at myKaarma and help shape the future of automotive service.

At myKaarma, exceptional customer interactions are the cornerstone of our success. Our platform is meticulously engineered to communicate with customers at every aspect of the service, repair, and maintenance journey, ensuring positive and memorable experiences.

### **Role Description**

As an **Implementation Specialist** at myKaarma, you will own the technical configuration and implementation readiness of our service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection solutions. You will partner directly with automotive dealership customers to understand their service workflows, operational needs, existing technology, and integration dependencies—then translate those requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.

You will serve as a technical escalation resource throughout the implementation process, resolving complex configuration challenges, confirming infrastructure readiness, and testing the complete customer journey before training begins. Working closely with Deployment Managers and the Training Team, you will ensure each solution is fully configured and prepared for a successful launch. You will also develop documentation, templates, automations, and repeatable processes that improve implementation efficiency and create a consistent customer experience.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Guide automotive dealership customers through the setup of myKaarma’s service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection tools, ensuring each solution is configured to support the dealership’s specific business needs.
* Lead detailed discovery sessions to understand each dealership’s current workflows, operating processes, and existing technology, including any systems that myKaarma will replace.
* Confirm that each assigned dealership has the required devices, network connectivity, and technical infrastructure in place well before implementation or onsite training begins.
* Test and demonstrate the configured solution with the customer before training, walking through the full service experience from appointment scheduling and customer arrival through vehicle inspection and service completion.
* Coordinate closely with the Deployment Manager and Training Team to communicate customer requirements, resolve configuration issues, and ensure each product is fully prepared for onsite or remote training.
* Develop templates, automations, and repeatable processes that make product setup more efficient, reduce manual administrative work, and allow more time for meaningful customer consultation.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 2+ years of experience in software implementation, deployment, customer onboarding, or a similar client-facing role.
* Experience working in automotive, Software as a Service (SaaS), or another technology-enabled service environment.
* Strong communication and customer consultation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements.
* Self-directed and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and deadlines.
* Comfortable using business tools such as Salesforce and Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Forms, and related applications.
* General understanding of software implementation processes and customer service best practices.

**Preferred/Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience working in automotive dealership service operations, such as service scheduling, customer check-in, repair orders, or vehicle inspections.
* Experience implementing or supporting software used by automotive dealerships.
* Familiarity with myKaarma products or similar dealership technology platforms.

jobs.title: AI Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
Epoch AI is looking for an AI Enablement Manager to help our team better utilize AI in our workflows. You would build and run automations that take routine work off people’s plates, keep our shared automations running smoothly, and help researchers and operations staff use frontier models better in their work.

### **About the Role**

Epoch already takes AI enablement work seriously. Since March 2026, we have had someone dedicated to this role. We have developed several dozen automations and put considerable effort into integrating Claude Tag (Claude’s Slack add-on) with all the services our staff use.

The work has two halves:

* Automate. Identify recurring work a system can do most of, and build that system. Some automations replace monotonous work we've been doing manually. Others do valuable work we haven't had the internal capacity to do.
* Upskill. Help people use AI themselves: onboarding, written guidance, one-to-one coaching, and shared infrastructure such as skills, prompt libraries, and tool integrations.

A key part of the job is judgment, not building. We could automate far more than one person can build. So you would rank opportunities by their expected value to the organization.

### **Practicalities**

**Location:** Global, Remote.

**Work Hours:** Flexible, work between UTC+2 and UTC-8.

**Travel Requirement:** Employees are expected to attend our 3 in-person retreats each year (locations vary).

**Compensation:** Annual salary of $125k - $155k USD, exact offer will factor in experience and location. Salaries are not restricted to USD; contracts and payments are usually in local currencies, converted at one-year average exchange rates.  
  
**Benefits:**

* Comprehensive health insurance program, including supplemental benefits specific to a local country, as available and mandated by local law
* Life insurance and retirement contributions plan, if applicable in your country
* Unlimited PTO with a recommend minimum of 30 days off per year (including public local holidays and vacation time)
* Unlimited personal and sick leave
* Parental leave — up to 4 months of paid leave for permanent staff with at least 12 months of tenure, prorated for those with less tenure, to be taken within the first year after a child’s birth or adoption
* A flexible and generous expense policy for you to spend on equipment and a large range of productivity tools or learning/development opportunities you might find valuable, subject to regulations and manager approval.
* Other benefits as allowed at the discretion of Epoch AI’s leadership and local availability

**Application Deadline:** Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply early

**Start Date:** As soon as the successful candidate is available

**Reports to:** COO

### **What You'll Own**

* Own Epoch’s portfolio of AI automations: keep the production systems running, fix them when they break, and retire the ones that have stopped earning their maintenance.
* Build automations for operations, communications, and research support. Understand colleagues’ needs and involve them in testing and refining the result.
* Prioritize deliberately. Estimate each project’s value, then use that to decide what to build next.
* Run our shared AI tools: Claude in Slack, the integrations that connect it to our systems, and the skills and prompts staff share. Review new tools and models as they come out, and recommend the ones worth adopting. Oversee our AI tool spend.
* Help staff use AI better. Run onboarding for new hires, write practical guidance, and offer one-to-one help. Keep our AI support channels a place where people are comfortable asking basic questions.
* Make each automation straightforward to hand over. Record how it works and how to maintain it, and ensure Epoch controls the accounts and access it depends on.
* Maintain the automations dashboard and report regularly on what changed: which workflows improved, for whom, and by how much.

### **About You**

* **Extensive practical experience with AI.** You have used coding agents to turn ideas into working tools and can take a project from initial problem to deployment. You experiment with new capabilities and judge whether they improve your work.
* **A systematic approach to building with AI agents.** You can translate a need into clear specifications, break work into manageable tasks, and assess design trade-offs. You understand how the resulting system fits together and can direct agents to implement it. You don’t need to write the code yourself.
* **Product judgment.** You start from the needs of the people who will use a tool. You think through how they will interact with it, including less common cases, and make deliberate choices about what to include and leave out. You aim for tools that are coherent, easy to use, and well suited to their purpose.
* **Resourcefulness and adaptability.** You enjoy exploring unfamiliar problems and finding ways to solve them. You can learn new tools, question an initial approach, and find alternatives when it falls short.
* **An aptitude for teaching and coaching.** You enjoy helping others become more capable. You listen carefully to understand their work and what they find difficult, adapt your explanations to their experience, and make people comfortable asking questions. You help colleagues apply AI to their own tasks and develop the confidence and judgment to use it independently.
* **Autonomy and reliability.** You can set your own priorities and follow through without being prompted. You would often be the only person working on a given problem.
* **Mission alignment.** You understand and share Epoch’s mission.

A background in software engineering is not required. These qualities describe our ideal candidate, but you don’t need to tick every box to be a great fit. If this role interests you and you think you could do it well, we encourage you to apply.

### **Additional Information**

**About the team**
------------------

Zillow’s Employee Service Center (ESC) delivers fast, accurate and scalable HR support to a distributed workforce. It owns HR transactions, data integrity and compliance, and partners with People Product and HR COEs on digital solutions. **Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 15,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Foreman to own commercial EV charging projects while leading installation work directly on site. This role combines the hands-on technical leadership of a Foreman with the planning, and client communication of a Project Manager. You will supervise an installation crew, manage project schedules and coordinate with engineering, procurement, and local authorities, and serve as the customer’s primary point of contact. Your leadership will be crucial in delivering safe, code-compliant, high-quality installations on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage commercial EV charging projects for the entirety of the project.

* Must be responsive to emails and phone calls from clients, crews, and management.

* 2+ years of project management experience on commercial electrical or construction projects, including scheduling and budget tracking.
* DIR Licensed Journeyman or Master Electrician (preferred).

**QUALITY ASSURANCE TECHNICIAN**

**Company:** VahatiCor  
**Status:** Full-time, Nonexempt  
**Location:** Onsite, Santa Clara, CA  
**Reports to:** Chief Operations Officer • Manufacturing

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

VahatiCor is a venture-backed medical technology company developing a new cardiovascular therapy. As the company grows beyond its startup incubator, it is building the quality systems and infrastructure needed to support its next stage.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Quality Assurance Technician will inspect and test materials, components, subassemblies, and finished cardiovascular medical devices. As a member of the Quality team, this person will also carry out material control and nonconformance activities, maintain manufacturing and inspection records, and participate in validation activities.

This is a hands-on role requiring medical device industry experience and the ability to work in compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), approved procedures, and established quality system requirements. Inspection activities include handling small components and spending extended periods looking through microscopes.

This person will work closely with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering. Success requires excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, accurate documentation, and a responsive, service-oriented approach to colleagues.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Inspection and Testing**

* Perform incoming inspection and testing of medical device materials and components using approved specifications, inspection procedures, and sampling plans.
* Collect and evaluate quality documentation accompanying incoming materials, including certificates of conformity, supplier inspection records, and other required documentation.
* Perform in-process inspection and testing of subassemblies and final inspection of completed medical devices.
* Inspect materials and products for applicable dimensional, visual, workmanship, labeling, and packaging requirements.
* Use microscopes for detailed inspection of small components, assemblies, and finished devices, including extended periods of microscope use.
* Use calipers, micrometers, height gauges, gauge blocks, optical inspection and measurement equipment, and other approved tools appropriate to assigned inspections.
* Document and communicate inspection results, test results, and nonconformances according to approved quality system procedures and good documentation practices.
* Work in cleanroom and electrostatic discharge-protected areas, as applicable, following required procedures for gowning, contamination control, and material handling.

**Material Control and Nonconformance Activities**

* Carry out material control procedures, including receipt verification, identification, quarantine, and movement of materials to and from Quality.
* Verify material identification, part numbers, revision levels, lot or serial numbers, quantities, and inspection status against approved documentation.
* Maintain material control, nonconformance, work order, and serial number logs and databases, as assigned.
* Identify and document nonconforming materials or products and coordinate their segregation and status labeling to prevent unintended use.
* Participate in the investigation, disposition, and documentation of nonconforming materials by gathering inspection results, measurements, manufacturing records, and other relevant information.
* Perform approved reinspection or verification following authorized rework or other disposition decisions.
* Escalate unresolved discrepancies and recurring defects to the appropriate Quality, Manufacturing, or Engineering personnel.

**Manufacturing and Quality Records**

* Contribute to and maintain lot records and Device History Records, including required inspection, manufacturing, and traceability information.
* Review records for completeness, accuracy, legibility, required signatures and dates, and use of current approved document revisions.
* Identify missing entries, inconsistent information, or incomplete approvals and coordinate correction with the responsible personnel.
* Follow good documentation practices when recording results or making corrections, preserving original information and required audit trails.
* Maintain organized records that are readily available for Quality review, product acceptance or release activities, audits, and retention.

**Inspection Procedures and Measurement Equipment**

* Develop and update inspection procedures, measurement programs, forms, and checklists in coordination with Quality and Engineering and through established document approval procedures.
* Identify unclear inspection instructions or acceptance criteria and obtain clarification before proceeding.
* Ensure inspection and measurement equipment is maintained and calibrated as required.
* Verify equipment calibration status and suitability before use and report damaged equipment, inconsistent readings, or other concerns that could affect results.
* Maintain inspection tools and work areas according to approved handling, storage, and housekeeping procedures.

**Validation Activities**

* Participate in the execution of approved process validation and test method validation protocols.
* Perform assigned activities for installation qualification, operational qualification, and performance qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), including inspection, measurement, and data collection.
* Participate in gauge repeatability and reproducibility studies to evaluate consistency of measurements across equipment and operators.
* Document results accurately and communicate deviations, unexpected findings, or execution questions to the responsible Quality or Engineering personnel.

**Quality System Compliance and Audits**

* Maintain working knowledge of procedures, specifications, and applicable quality requirements related to assigned responsibilities.

**Schedule**: Monday to Friday (8am-4:30pm)

**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs , LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

LifeMoves’ Homeless Outreach Teams (HOT) conduct outreach to unsheltered individuals experiencing homelessness. HOT collaborates with multiple internal and community organizations to provide holistic services to help the individuals return to stability. HOT is a subset of a larger Outreach team that includes Rapid Response Dispatch and an Encampment Resolution team.

The HOT Case Manager supports unsheltered individuals in accessing housing, healthcare, and other vital resources. Through direct outreach and intensive case management, they build trust, set client-centered goals, and provide flexible, trauma-informed support. Reporting to the Program Director, the CM meets clients where they are and helps guide them toward stability and self-sufficiency, while also engaging with the broader community through education and advocacy.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop, implement, and revise individual case plans with housing/employment/benefit/health and well being tasks based on client strengths and goals.
* Support clients with tasks including but not limited to housing searches, employment preparation, benefits access, life skills development, build resumes, cover letters, and navigate employment and housing resources.
* Support clients with enrollment into benefit programs including but not limited to General Assistance, CalFresh, and Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants.
* Coordinate with health care access to understand and support client physical and behavioral health needs. Assist clients by scheduling medical appointments, arranging transportation, and accompanying them to appointments as needed.
* Facilitate client-centered groups, workshops, or education sessions to build skills and confidence.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community partners by building strong relationships, connecting clients to needed resources and services, and educating the community on client needs and trauma-informed care.
* Coordinate with relevant public partners, for example probation officers, Veterans Affairs, Adult Protective Services (APS), Child Protective Services (CPS) and city, state, and federal agencies, to support client needs and program goals.

**Client Advocacy, Mediation, and Conflict Resolution**

* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords, employers, or agencies to support successful outcomes. Provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Advocate for client rights and reduce stigma around homelessness and mental health challenges. Advocate for clients' needs and strengths when working with partners, landlords, employers, and other agencies.

**Data Tracking and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, case notes, reports, and program data in line with agency standards and confidentiality laws utilizing Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the LifeMoves internal client management system
* Track client progress, program outcomes, housing placements, employment and learning successes, and community partnerships.

**Crisis Management and Safety**

* Provide crisis intervention and make referrals to appropriate services when needed.

* Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
* Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying what you learn to your daily work.

The person we're looking for is a steady, organized, solutions-oriented go-to who keeps queues healthy, makes sound policy-aligned calls on tough cases, and stays close to customers by handling contacts 40 to 50% of the time.

**What You'll Own**

* Monitor queues, channels and backlogs throughout the day, flagging volume spikes, aging tickets and SLA risk.
* Rebalance work across the team as directed by the Team Lead.
* Run daily huddles and share updates, policy changes and known issues.

* Take the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve and own them through to resolution.

* Act as the go-to resource during the day for questions on policies, procedures and systems.
* Guide agents through tricky cases in the moment, and share observations on agent strengths and gaps with the Team Lead, who owns coaching.
* Support onboarding as a buddy for new team members.
* Coordinate with internal partners, especially Logistics and Order Operations, to resolve day-to-day issues on individual orders and cases.
* Spend 40 to 50% of your time handling customer contacts via email, chat, SMS and phone, delivering clear, timely and empathetic communication focused on first-contact resolution, in each brand's unique voice.

**What You'll Drive**

* Identify recurring escalation themes and share them with the Team Lead to inform training and process updates.
* Reinforce established processes and quality standards, and keep team reference materials current in partnership with Systems and Tools.

### **We Are Looking for People Who**

Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review is a remote review track for evaluating AI outputs across recruiting workflows. Reviewers grade workflow correctness, policy adherence, and stakeholder fit; flag operational risk; and document the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.

**Why this role matters**
-------------------------

Recruiting AI has to fit into an actual day at work. AuraOne uses experienced operators to grade outputs the way a senior peer would — checking workflow, policy, and the unwritten rules that decide whether a task actually gets done.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current recruiting workflows, playbooks, and firm policy for Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review assignments.
* Grade tone, escalation logic, and stakeholder fit on a structured rubric.
* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published playbooks or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Direct working experience in recruiting on real teams for Recruitment Operations Manager — AI Workflow Review work.
* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the policy or workflow being applied.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.

**Example tasks**
-----------------

* Grade a model's response to a real recruiting ticket and rate workflow, tone, and escalation.
* Flag a missed escalation with the right severity tag and corrected next step.
* Adjudicate a disputed playbook call between two reviewers using firm guidance.
* Audit a 25-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Prior experience training, calibrating, or QA-ing operations teams.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted workflow tooling and its failure modes.
* Bilingual experience for cross-region operations.
